defect.name: V34 replay TTL is not enforced while the state is idle
defect.reason: V34 _enforce_replay_budget_locked() contains the intended 6-hour replay expiry, but V34 calls it only from finalize_provider_result(). ConversationSegmentStore.get()/status() call _cleanup_locked(), and V34 _cleanup_locked() performs only 30-day conversation TTL/LRU cleanup. Therefore an exact replay payload containing response text/tool arguments can remain on disk well beyond REPLAY_TTL when no later provider result is finalized.
defect.worst_case: With no later finalize, replay payload lifetime follows ordinary conversation persistence rather than the declared six-hour replay retention boundary.

candidate.behavior: Make replay budget/TTL enforcement part of every store cleanup path, return whether replay state changed, and make get()/status() persist that cleanup through their existing changed->save path.

next: Apply V34 then V35 to the exact conversation_segments.py candidate before server integration. Re-run exact store regressions including an idle >6h replay-expiry case and a forced cleanup-write failure. Only then integrate provider intent/replay ordering into exact server.py.
